title: Recursive level matrix condition
statement: Let $w,r,p\in\mathbb{N}$, let $E$ be a relation on Boolean lists, let $A,B$ be Boolean lists, and let $\tau:\mathbb{N}\to\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$. For $i\in\mathbb{N}$, write $R_i$ for the length-$w$ block $(\tau(i),\tau(i+1),\ldots,\tau(i+w-1))$. At level $0$, the condition is $E(A,B)$. At level $r+1$, the condition is that if either $R_p=A$ and $R_{p+w}=R_{p+2w}$, or $R_p=R_{p+2w}$ and $R_{p+w}=B$, then the level-$r$ condition holds at index $p+3w$, with endpoints $R_{p+w}$ and $R_{p+2w}$ and sequence $\tau$.
hypotheses_covered: Relation $E$ on pairs of Boolean lists
